description: A Fair Trade Greetings, <race>. I am Kolark, Bounty <class> from Thunderbluff. Much of the world I have traveled and much I have seen. My journeys across the South Seas led to the discovery of these wonderous thorium headed arrows. Alas, I have an endless supply of the arrows but have exhausted my supply of shells. Bah, no self respecting Tauren would ever be caught dead using a flimsy bow. The arrows are useless! I will offer a trade: An even exchange of thorium shells for my thorium headed arrows. Deal? Requirements: - Thorium Shells x 200
name: A Fair Trade
